scope.implementation: KR exact-concept annual statement input recovery and synthetic comparison rehearsals
scope.KR: FY2016-2024 candidate pairs; prospective FY2025 inputs counted separately; signal-close PIT Top120 intersection NOT YET MEASURED
scope.US: Raw concept-presence census only; no new US financial signal values or WID extension
scope.signalScheduleProposed: Each issuer-year: first Friday KRX session strictly after annual publication, next exchange session open entry. Holiday Friday has no new signal; following Friday remains eligible. Calendar/source cohort must be sealed before label access.
scope.maturity: Next exchange-session open through Hth session close; unobservable or unresolved outcomes retain intended denominators and block that comparison. Calendar determines maturity, not provider emptiness. No complete-block stitching or last-price terminal substitution.

hypotheses.name: collection_discipline
hypotheses.formula: tradeReceivables(prev separately published FY)/sales(prev FY) - tradeReceivables(current FY)/sales(current FY)
hypotheses.economicQuestion: Does less cash tied up in customer credit predict additional net stock-relative performance, beyond sales growth, level profitability, aggregate accruals, value and momentum?
hypotheses.neverSubstitute: TradeAndOtherCurrentReceivables, noncurrent receivables or latest-filed comparative columns

hypotheses.name: inventory_discipline
hypotheses.formula: inventories(prev separately published FY)/sales(prev FY) - inventories(current FY)/sales(current FY)
hypotheses.economicQuestion: Does inventory build relative to revenue contain demand/obsolescence information absent from aggregate NI-OCF accruals and profitability?
refutations: industry cycle and inflation rather than stock selection
hypotheses.neverSubstitute: Inventory components, costs of goods sold inferred from revenue or missing inventory as zero

inputRules: Both annual filings separately visible strictly before signal date; no comparative-column backfill.
Same issuer and CFS/OFS basis, consecutive fiscal years, one exact concept and KRW undimensioned row per leg.
Taxonomy concept change abstains, including ifrs to ifrs-full; no outcome-driven mapping expansion.
Raw annual label does not prove twelve-month duration or original unamended vintage: separate source qualification required.
Signal pair, universe, industry/size controls, source SHA and calendar must be pre-label sealed; SHA is an integrity check, not authority.
Each intended name/date remains in coverage denominator, with independent nonexclusive missing reasons.

baselines: existing momentum, book/earnings valuation, operating profitability, aggregate accruals, log size, log ADV, sales growth, focal working-capital level and industry-date controls
comparisonPlan.augmentation: One WC signal per comparison. No two-signal weighted composite or hyperparameter search.
comparisonPlan.models: Fixed Ridge alpha=1 only after simple signal and constant baseline; train-only imputer/scaler. No nonlinear model unless separate future version.
comparisonPlan.splitProposed: Expanding training; evaluate chronological calendar years 2020-2025; realized label close strictly before evaluation-year start minus 21 exchange sessions. First years may be blocked by training minima.
comparisonPlan.missingOutcomes: Whole intended date comparison blocked. No use of realized availability to select membership. Report all blocked dates and missing reasons; do not claim full-population effect from complete cases.
targets: net shareholder stock return minus matched ETF net return
stock minus leave-one-out same-industry return on identical cost/basis/date rules
concentrationSensitivity: exclude dated signal top-two market-cap names
exclude fixed semiconductor/electronics taxonomy labels before outcomes
comparisonPlan.sizes: Dated size groups; no reconstructed shares proxy silently called certified market capitalization

costsKRProposed.stockSellTax: dated kr_sell_tax_bps(exit), ETF stock transaction tax 0

comparisonPlan.distributions: Gross distributions/reinvested delivered rights on both legs, net explicit trading costs/tax; not personal after-dividend-tax wealth. Complete distribution/actions ledger and execution cash timing required.
comparisonPlan.portfolioProposed: Separate later adapter: at most 5 stocks, equal 20% slots with ETF fallback, capacity from raw contemporaneous price/volume; ETF-only and baseline-versus-augmented paired books; 50m KRW research NAV and 1% median60-session turnover cap. Not D or a production risk budget.
comparisonPlan.statisticalFamily: Reserve 12 signal-horizon-region/benchmark contrasts (2 signals x 2 horizons x KR/SPY/QQQ); unexecuted/blocked tests assigned p=1 if reporting a family correction. Industry target/ablation/sensitivities descriptive, never alternate primary discoveries.
comparisonPlan.uncertainty: Year-cluster and horizon-length block resampling, Holm .05 across fixed family; count valid pairs and independent blocks separately for every contrast; no finite inferential CI or SUPPORTED if fewer than 10 independent blocks. Normal MDE planning optimistic; disclose available years and achieved sample, never post-hoc power as proof.
comparisonPlan.smallSample: FY2016-2024 gives at most 9 annual signal-year clusters before further loss. Inferential minimum may be unreachable. Approved pilot can report descriptive effects and exclusion rates, not a reliable alpha finding or independent OOS.
comparisonPlan.downside: Loss-tail classification and portfolio MDD/CVaR/turnover/concentration only after valid complete shareholder paths exist; no incomplete-path CAGR/Sharpe.

Signal-date PIT universe/industry/size intersection, intended-cohort/source/calendar seal and source-rights evidence
